title: server: run signature/KeyPackage checks off async workers
description: From the .7.28 investigation: CPU-heavy signature and KeyPackage verification runs directly on tokio worker threads; under load this can starve a task holding the SQLite write lock. Consider spawn_blocking for those checks. Per clarity-over-performance, do it only with a measured problem; it is not needed for the .7.28 fix (decision mimid-1wgh.42).
